description: Guide defensive security incident handling on systems the user owns or is authorized to investigate: triage and scoping, evidence preservation in order of volatility, containment decisions, timeline building, eradication/recovery planning and post-incident review, aligned with NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 and RFC 3227. Use when the user suspects a compromise (unexpected logins, malware, leaked credentials, ransomware signs, data exposure) and needs a structured, evidence-safe plan. Not for operational outages without a security angle (use linux-troubleshooting or logging-observability), proactive hardening (use linux-hardening), threat modeling (threat-modeling), offensive testing, or attacking/retaliating against an adversary.
